column1: # Destination walkability exceptions — curated suppression list for the
# The check flags every destination TSV target that is blocked (has no
# cardinal movement flags) on the committed collision-map.zip. Some
# destinations are unreachable by design: NPC-serviced banks with no
# standable booth tile, tiles the player interacts with from an adjacent
# tile, arrival spots the game relocates you off, or instanced interiors
# the committed map does not cover. Listing a tile here suppresses the
# advisory finding for exactly that tile — nothing else.
# Row contract: "X Y Z<TAB>reason" — the coordinate in the same
# space-separated three-part form the Destination column uses, then a
# human reason explaining why the tile is by-design unreachable. A row
# without both parts is a malformed line and fails the check closed
# (scripts refuse to silently ignore a suppression that might be a typo).
# Curate entries as findings are triaged; this file starts empty.
